boot.error.corpus: Plumbline could not read the scripture data on this device. Reloading re-downloads what is missing.
boot.error.engine: The study engine stopped before Plumbline finished opening. Reloading starts it again.
boot.error.network: Plumbline could not finish downloading what it needs to open. Check the connection and try again. Once it is on the device it opens with no connection at all.
boot.error.quota: There is no room left on this device to store the Bible.
boot.error.stale: This copy of Plumbline is older than the scripture data it just downloaded. Reload the page to pick up the current version.
boot.error.storage: This browser is not letting Plumbline store anything on the device. Site data (cookies and storage) has to be allowed for this address. A private window may block it too.
boot.error.unknown: Plumbline could not start. Reloading usually clears it; if it does not, the details below are what a bug report needs.
boot.error.wasm: Plumbline's engine would not start in this browser. Closing other tabs and reloading is worth trying; if it keeps happening, the browser may be too old for WebAssembly.

intro.beforeShareSub: This app will enable you to easily share the gospel with someone. If they keep the app afterwards, this is how they find your church.
intro.churchWhy: If you add your church, the links and QR codes you share contain your church information, so whoever you hand the Bible to can also find your church. It stays on your device and your data remains private.
intro.curious.p1: For thousands of years this text has been the foundation of civilizations and of the lives of individuals. People have been killed for reading it and for sharing it.
intro.curious.p2: It contains the history of our world from its creation to the incarnation of its Creator here on earth with us. He came to save us because he loves us:
intro.curious.p3: Whether you are just curious or returning to faith after a long time, there is treasure here for you:
intro.curious.p4: If you are having trouble believing, you're not alone — someone said exactly that to Jesus himself:
intro.curious.p5: I encourage you to read this book starting with the book of John, and to pray that if God is real, he would reveal himself to you. I've known many people for whom that prayer has been answered:
intro.curious.struggle: If you are in a difficult place in your life, ask God to help you with your struggles:
intro.curious.title: I'm glad you're curious about the Bible.
intro.humanDesc: Curated scholarship: how the text renders each original word (agapaō → “love” ×27 · “beloved” ×13…), word grammar, the same root traced across the testaments, and the Treasury's cross-references.
intro.humanShort: Curated scholarship: how the text renders each original word, word grammar, the same root traced across the testaments, and the Treasury's cross-references.
intro.machineDesc: Statistical patterns: the words a word keeps company with, and where in the Bible it clusters.
intro.machineShort: Statistical patterns: the words a word keeps company with, where in the Bible it is most used, and where its repetitions cluster.
intro.pathCuriousDesc: I'm not sure what I believe — where do I start?
intro.pathEstablishedDesc: Set up your Bible for study and memorization and prepare to share the good news with others.
intro.pathNewDesc: Where to start if you have just put your faith in Jesus.
intro.pathSharingDesc: Share the gospel and your church from your phone.
intro.provenance: Every piece of evidence is marked with where it comes from — ✝ the text · † scholarship · ≈ machine.
intro.sub: The Holy Bible in a free, offline app. Where would you like to begin?
intro.subShort:
The Holy Bible, free and offline.
Where would you like to begin?
intro.tapHint: Tap any verse reference to open it.
intro.tiersSub: Reading, search, memorization, tags, and notes are all available in this application. Choose which additional analysis tools are installed with the Bible.
intro.title: Welcome to Plumbline
intro.welcome.blessing: May the peace and joy of Christ be with you, and may you share that peace and joy with others. God bless you!
intro.welcome.church: Being part of a local church is a great way to grow in your faith and connect with believers.
intro.welcome.churchMerged: Being part of a local church is a great way to grow in your faith and connect with believers. If someone shared this app with you, consider reaching out to them or attending a Sunday morning service at their church.
intro.welcome.churchNone: If someone shared this app with you, consider reaching out to them or attending a Sunday morning service at their church.
intro.welcome.churchShared: This Bible was shared with you by {church}. Start there: they would be glad to see you, and whoever gave you this can introduce you.
intro.welcome.forgiven: One day you will be perfected, but not yet, and so while you are here, you are imperfect but you are forgiven:
intro.welcome.kept: No one can take it away from you, and you can know that for certain:
intro.welcome.lead: There are some next steps you can take to grow in faith:
intro.welcome.loved: Know that Jesus loves you, and if you trust in him for your salvation, then you have eternal life:
intro.welcome.memorize: This app can also help you memorize scripture — hiding the word in your heart is a wise and helpful thing to do.
intro.welcome.read: The next page will open in the book of John, which is a great place to start reading the inspired, inerrant word of God. You've been linked the King James Version, which is the closest to the original texts and has been used for hundreds of years by millions of believers. If you have trouble with the older English, turn on the Plain-English overlay in Settings: it marks the words the American King James Version puts differently, so a modern wording is a tap away without ever leaving the King James text.
intro.welcome.struggle: If you are in a difficult place in your life, ask God to help you with your struggles:
intro.welcome.title: I'm so glad you've put your faith in Jesus!
intro.welcome.wisdom: I highly recommend you read your Bible as it is rich with wisdom on how to navigate this world and how to serve our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ:
